## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`composer test`, `pnpm test`)

- [ ] Schema contract updated in `packages/core/src/schema` (if PHP output changed)
- [ ] React, Vue **and** Svelte renderers updated (or unsupported behaviour documented)
- [ ] Docs updated in `docs/content`
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) for npm packages / `CHANGELOG.md` entry for PHP
